name: Blaupunkt ODx 2.100D Class-D 2-Channel Amplifier
description: Compact 2/1 channel Class-D high-efficiency amplifier delivering 600W max total output. Features 2x100W RMS at 4 ohms, 1x300W RMS bridged, and >95dB signal-to-noise ratio. Designed with ultra-compact dimensions (160mm x 112mm x 53mm) for stealth vehicle installs.

name: Blaupunkt ODx 4.100D Class-D 4-Channel Amplifier
description: Versatile 4/3/2 channel Class-D full-range amplifier with 1200W max total power output. Delivers 4x100W RMS at 4 ohms, 4x150W RMS at 2 ohms, and 2x300W RMS bridged with active low/high pass crossovers and thermal protection.

name: Blaupunkt PDx 4.120D High-Power 4-Channel Amplifier
description: Premium Class-D power stage delivering 1400W peak output with 4x120W RMS at 4 ohms and 2x320W RMS bridged. Equipped with precision frequency tuning, gold-plated RCA terminals, and an advanced aluminium heatsink.

name: Blaupunkt Velocity VA 1004 4-Channel Amplifier
description: Flagship Blaupunkt Velocity series 4/2 channel amplifier with selectable bass boost (0/6/12 dB at 45Hz), 24dB steep high-pass filter, and 720W max power. Delivers studio-grade audio staging across component and coaxial systems.

name: Blaupunkt BPM 110 4G Dash Cam & GPS Dual-Channel Tracker
description: Connected 4G intelligent dual-channel vehicle recording and telematics system. Offers 2K crystal-clear front recording, rear view recording, real-time live GPS tracking, emergency collision SOS upload, and cloud remote surveillance via mobile app.

name: Blaupunkt Key Largo 1010 9-Inch Android Multimedia Head Unit
description: 9.0-inch capacitive IPS touchscreen (1280x800) powered by Android with Wireless PhoneLINK (Apple CarPlay & Android Auto). Features 2GB RAM, 32GB storage, quad-core 1.5GHz processor, 10-band equalizer, 4x50W max output, and AHD reverse camera support.

name: RECOIL RL1200.4 4-Channel RMS 1200 Watts Amplifier
description: Ultra-compact 4-channel power amplifier built for full-range system upgrades where space is tight. Rated at 4x300W RMS at 2 ohms and bridgeable to 2x520W RMS at 4 ohms. Features independent HPF/LPF crossovers (30-300Hz), 4-way protection circuitry, and clip LED indicator.

name: RECOIL REA600.4 600 Watts Class A/B 4-Channel Amplifier
description: Audiophile-grade Class A/B 4-channel full-range car amplifier. Delivers 4x130W RMS at 2 ohms, 4x95W RMS at 4 ohms, and 2x260W RMS bridged. Engineered with high-speed MOSFET power supply, 20Hz-20kHz response, and 0-12dB bass boost.

name: RECOIL RL680.4 Pocket-Size 680 Watts 4-Channel Amplifier
description: Pocket-sized 4-channel Class-D micro amplifier measuring just 3.97" x 4.92" x 2.0". Delivers 4x170W at 2 ohms, 4x95W at 4 ohms, and 2x250W bridged. Perfect for space-constrained EV bikes, scooters, convertibles, and compact cars.

name: RECOIL R3B-P 3-Inch All-Weather Speaker Audio Kit
description: Complete waterproof 3-inch handlebar speaker audio package for motorcycles, EV two-wheelers, and ATVs. Includes pair of matte black UV-stable speaker pods, a compact 360W Class-D amplifier with Bluetooth 5.0, handlebar clamps (0.75"-1.25"), and wireless remote controller.

name: RECOIL BTR-20 Waterproof Bluetooth 5.0 Audio Receiver
description: High-resolution marine and automotive Bluetooth 5.0 audio streamer powered by Qualcomm QCC3034 chipset. Supports 24-bit lossless codecs (aptX-HD, aptX-LL, AAC). Provides 4V RMS stereo line output, remote amp turn-on trigger, and IPX7 immersion rating.

name: RECOIL Echo Pro RX65 6.5-Inch 2-Way Coaxial Speakers
description: High-performance 6.5-inch 2-way coaxial car speakers rated at 140W peak / 70W RMS per driver. Features woven fiberglass composite cone, butyl rubber surround, 1.0" silk dome tweeter with neodymium motor, and 60Hz-20kHz response.

name: RECOIL RLS10 10-Inch Low-Profile Amplified Subwoofer
description: Slim 2.95-inch height under-seat powered subwoofer housing a high-excursion 10" woofer and 300W peak / 150W RMS Class-D amplifier. Features auto signal sensing, wired bass level remote, variable low-pass (50-150Hz), and bass boost.

specifications.Controls: Wired Remote Bass Knob & Low-Pass Filter

name: Riderzpro Custom-Fit Leatherette Seat Covers
description: Cut on your car actual seat pattern with airbag-safe tear seams on the side bolsters. Diamond, hexagon or plain stitch in breathable perforated PU leather.

name: Riderzpro Butyl Sound Deadening Kit — 4 Door
description: Butyl-and-aluminium constrained layer damper plus closed-cell foam. Drops door resonance, kills road drum and makes every speaker sound one class better.

specifications.Material: Pure Butyl Rubber with Reinforced Aluminum Foil

name: Riderzpro All-Weather Triple-Layer Waterproof Body Cover
description: Heavy-duty triple-layer car cover featuring UV-reflective outer membrane, waterproof middle barrier, and ultra-soft scratch-resistant cotton fleece lining. Protects clear coat from monsoon rain, tree sap, bird droppings, and UV oxidation.
warranty: 1 Year against seam failure and fading

name: Riderzpro Portable Twin-Cylinder 150 PSI Air Compressor
description: Industrial-grade twin-cylinder 12V air compressor outputting 160 litres/minute. Inflates four standard SUV tyres from 18 to 32 PSI in under 9 minutes. Includes heavy-duty battery alligator clamps, 8-metre coiled air hose, analogue pressure gauge, and puncture kit bag.

name: VoltRide 60V 30Ah Lithium NMC Replacement Battery Pack
description: Automotive-grade 60V 30Ah (1.8 kWh) Lithium NMC replacement battery pack with integrated intelligent CAN-bus BMS. Delivers up to 1800 cycles @ 80% DoD with IP67 laser-welded casing.

specifications.BMS: Smart CAN-Bus 60A with Bluetooth App Monitoring

name: Deccan 48V 28Ah Heavy Duty Swappable LiFePO4 Battery
description: Ultra-safe Prismatic LiFePO4 swappable battery module built for heavy daily commuters with over 3000 charge cycles, plug-and-play Chogori connectors, and low self-discharge.

name: ChargeMax Pro 60V 5A Smart Fast Aluminum Charger
description: Compact aluminum fin-cooled high-efficiency fast charger with automated CC/CV profile, auto-cutoff, OVP, OCP, and dual MagLev silent cooling fans.

name: Southern Apex Weatherproof Home Charging Dock 2.2kW
description: Wall-mountable IP67 weatherproof 2.2kW residential fast-charging station with 5-metre heavy gauge copper cable and automatic power surge isolation.

name: RideSafe AeroShield Pro Full-Face ECE 22.06 Helmet
description: Dual-certified ISI and ECE 22.06 aerodynamic full-face helmet with Pinlock-ready optical visor, laser-cut hypoallergenic cheek pads, and wind-tunnel engineered chin vents.

specifications.Visor: Pinlock 70 Anti-Fog Ready with Quick Release

name: SMK Typhoon Full-Face Dual Visor Motorcycle Helmet
description: High-impact thermoplastic full-face motorcycle helmet equipped with internal retractable sun visor, channelled multi-density EPS, and quick-release micrometric buckle.

name: Kavach Sintered Ceramic Front Brake Pad Set
description: High-performance sintered ceramic-copper front disc brake pads engineered for regenerative and mechanical electric two-wheeler braking with heat tolerance up to 650°C.

specifications.Fitment: Direct Bolt-On for Ola S1, Ather 450X, TVS iQube

name: Brembo Wave Stainless Steel Disc Brake Rotor 220mm
description: Precision laser-cut 420 stainless wave rotor with perimeter cooling ports for fast heat dissipation, reduced unsprung mass, and crisp braking bite under hard stops.

specifications.Compatibility: Universal Front Hub for EV Scooters

name: VoltRide High-Discharge Smart BMS 60V 50A with Bluetooth
description: Intelligent battery management system designed for 16S Li-ion and NMC packs with active cell balancing, dual temperature sensors, and smartphone Bluetooth diagnostic telemetry.

name: Apex Carbon Steel 78T Reinforced Drive Belt Replacement
description: Carbon-fiber reinforced tensile core drive belt engineered for high instantaneous torque EV scooters, eliminating belt stretch and tooth shearing under rapid acceleration.

specifications.Durability: Resistant to Oil, Heat, and Ozone Degradation
